name: Ochiru Henshin Heroine
source:
Battle Sorceress Aqua is a heroine of justice who battles the forces of darkness.
But one day, the forces of darkness set a sex trap that snared Aqua.
The forces of darkness used their dark, dark magic.
Aqua forgot her own reason for existence in that pleasure abyss...
